required_outputs: Scores and rank interval under every approved vector.
Pairwise reversals and ties, preserving precision.
One-at-a-time cost sensitivity for demand, utilization, transition duration, unit price and residual liabilities.
Inputs, missingness and reviewer approval receipts.
interpretation: Rank reversal indicates preference dependence; stability does not establish causal truth, authority or benefit realization.
missing_input_rule: Do not impute scores or use budget size as an opportunity proxy. No ranking can be calculated from this design file alone.
